name: 线框羽化 · Wireframe Metamorphosis
description: RepoChan's own wireframe-metamorphosis landing page: a single sticky stage where the same composition morphs from ASCII wireframe and gray boxes through character lineart, flat color, texture and full render into a live brand world — scroll drives the RENDER 0–100% rail, layer toggles and reduced-motion stage snapshots included. zh default locale with a full en edition; every key visual is real pipeline output.

assets.description: Full-body die-cut cutout (pose A: low-angle diagonal leap) — the page's final-render character, reused across the FLAT/TEXTURE/RENDER/LIVE/WORLD stages via CSS filter states. Transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (2:3). Apply this slot before lineart-full: the lineart is redrawn on top of this cutout's pose.

brief.intent: Regenerate the final-render cutout for the downstream project's character, keeping the reference matte's full-body framing and energetic in-air pose so the page's wireframe-to-live crossfade lands on it.
mustInclude: one full-body character in an energetic mid-air pose, fully inside the canvas
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character
vertical 2:3 framing, character centered

assets.description: Full-body character lineart (pure black lines on white, keyed to transparent) — the 30% LINEART stage, crossfading into the final cutout. Reference is the cutout-a slot's current asset: the lineart MUST reproduce that cutout's pose, framing and proportions, so apply cutout-a first and hand its output to the painter as the pose reference. White matte is removed by chroma-key, then compressed to webp.

brief.intent: Redraw the downstream project's character as a clean full-body lineart that exactly matches the current cutout-a pose, framing and canvas share, so the page can crossfade lineart into the final render at the same slot position.
mustInclude: one full-body character lineart, same pose, position and proportions as the cutout-a reference, fully inside the canvas with margin on all sides
recognizable character features: face, hair, outfit and signature accessories in clean outline
pure black lines on a pure white background — no screentone, no gray fill, no shading

assets.description: Character foundation sheet — the FLAT stage's pinned thumbnail that reveals where the palette comes from. Square 1:1, compressed to 1024px webp.

brief.intent: Regenerate the foundation sheet for the downstream project's character: full-body anchor pose, chibi variant, expression headshots, palette swatches and key-motif callouts — the consistency anchor every downstream order references.
mustInclude: one main full-body character illustration plus one chibi and three expression headshots, all the same character
compact palette swatches with readable color-name labels
key-motif callouts with short readable labels
balanced concept-sheet composition on a neat flat background
avoid: a single element dominating the layout

assets.description: Seamless brand pattern tile — the TEXTURE stage's tiled backdrop and the WORLD stage's ambient layer. Square tile, compressed to 800px webp.

brief.intent: Regenerate the seamless pattern tile for the downstream project: small brand motifs in a subtle, evenly distributed repeat that tiles cleanly behind content.
mustInclude: a perfectly seamless square tile (edges continue across the wrap)
small project motifs distributed evenly at low contrast, subtle enough to sit behind text
the project palette
avoid: hard seams or obvious grid rhythm
creativeFreedom: palette rotation within the project identity

assets.description: Wide studio scene — the RENDER stage's backdrop card that the finished character stands in front of. Landscape 3:2, compressed to 1536px webp. Reference is the original scene plate; it carries scene composition (wide interior, character-scale space), not style lock-in.

brief.intent: Repaint the wide studio scene for the downstream project: a landscape interior where the project character plausibly works, composed so a cutout character can stand in front of it at the same slot.
mustInclude: landscape 3:2 wide scene with clear floor/grounding for a standing character
the project world rendered in full color with light and shadow
composition that keeps the center foreground open for an overlaid character
creativeFreedom: time of day and lighting mood

assets.description: Project icon — rail badge that switches from wireframe SVG to color at 85% progress, plus the WORLD stage's app-icon chip; also the favicon source (favicon.ico / apple-touch-icon.png / icon-192.png / icon-512.png are derived from it offline via compress + favicon + resize).

mustInclude: one scalable brand mark reading cleanly at 24px
project motif without any letterforms
creativeFreedom: accent colors from the project palette

assets.description: Nine die-cut chibi stickers from one 3×3 sheet — the page orbits cells 0/3/6 around the character in the TEXTURE and WORLD stages; the rest ship for downstream reuse. sticker-N.webp is cell N of the 3×3 grid; the source grid's cell semantics (chibi expressions) differ from the template's fixed keys, and the keys are the positional replacement contract for downstream regeneration.

mustInclude: strict 3×3 grid of the project character in the nine fixed web-state poses (template cell semantics)
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character, identical in every pixel outside the stickers
creativeFreedom: expression and pose details inside each fixed semantic
